newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank sells 780 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank sells 780 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank sold 780.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills, OFZ interest-bearing government bonds and VSM railway bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold.

The 21075 issue closed on Thursday at 84.58 percent, the 21076 issue closed at 84.35 percent, the 21077 issue closed at 84.06 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 83.79 percent, the 22081 issue closed at 99.20 percent, the 23003 issue closed at 88.91 percent, the 23005 issue closed at 86.62 percent, the 23007 issue closed at 85.42 percent, the 25001 issue closed at 102.39 percent and 22VSM03305 issue closed at 98.06 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
